marker_reviews.reason: The dynamic marker is the existence-guarded REVOKE EXECUTE loop over the 12 pinned security-definer signatures. No sidecar check kind can assert role privileges: the supported kinds are exact_row_count, catalog_contract and catalog_absence, none of which expresses has_function_privilege state, and the functions remain present (catalog_absence would be false). The durable proof is the in-migration post-revoke assertion (the same DO block raises if any in-scope signature that exists still grants EXECUTE to anon or authenticated) plus the preview after-census on issue #6455 and the named rollback in the migration header.
